## Checklist
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`type(scope): subject`); it becomes the commit on `main`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; the checks for the changed part pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] UI change: checked in the browser, light and dark theme (screenshot below)
- [ ] Architectural decision: ADR added in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] Docs updated if they became stale (README, `docs/`)
- [ ] No secrets in the diff
